handshake.HELLO: schema3 and encounter-v1 capability; own device/pet identity +fresh link nonce and echoed advertisement challenge; oldschema2 rejected before mutation.
handshake.OFFER: Reserve a durable own encounter counter for this peer when its valid HELLO is accepted; exchange immutable offer counters/pet identities. At most8 full pending records; capacity rejection does not reserve or overwrite. Local confirmation unavailable until complete pair offer tuple/encounterId is known.
handshake.LOCAL_BUTTON_CONSENT: At actual local button action, recheck current local snapshot petId and selected remote identity against offer; persist full local/remote pet strings and local-consent bit for exact binding before sending CONSENT. No auto-confirm on reconnect.
handshake.CONSENT_RECEIVED: Validate full pair binding; persist remote-consent observation. Duplicate exact bytes idempotent; conflicting tuple blocks.
handshake.LOCAL_PREPARED: Only after both consent bits durable; persist PREPARED before emitting PREPARED certificate.
handshake.LOCAL_COMMITTED: Only after local PREPARED and matching remote PREPARED certificate are durable; persist COMMITTED before emitting COMMIT certificate.
handshake.PEER_COMMIT_OBSERVED: Persist matching peer COMMIT certificate for same binding; distinguish from local completion. Never derive from gift ACK/DONE.
handshake.LOCAL_COMPLETE: Only local COMMITTED plus durable peer COMMIT observed, current/bound local identity matches, freeFIFO and event counter available: ONE blob commit changes first-complete bit and appends peer_complete event. Failure/uncertain commit sends no false success; reload authoritative blob before retry.
handshake.QUEUE_FULL: Durable committed/proof state retained, completion/event not claimed; retry after legitimate phone ACK releases FIFO space. Peer may already complete; no global all-or-none claim.
handshake.RETRANSMIT: Persisted phase certificates resend same tuple on reconnect. Last COMMIT loss can yield temporary asymmetric local events; eventual reliable reconnect converges without new counters/event duplication.
handshake.AFTER_PHONE_ACK: Release full binding slot only after ACK of that peer_complete event in same state commit; keep counters+bindingFingerprint+first-complete bit forever. Completed compact COMMIT can be resent using immutable ledger after full slot released; peer validates against its own full binding. Current HELLO identities must recompute same fingerprint or reject.

pendingAndLedger.backpressure: 8 full slots occupied => ENCOUNTER_BUSY/defer; no new consent/reservation/event. ACK frees full slot, never completion watermark. 32 peer keys remain lifetime cap with no implicit eviction.
pendingAndLedger.bindingVerification: Every message and completion validates full slot against immutable ledger and fingerprint. Queued peer_complete must retain its full slot; missing binding makes decode fail closed. After ACK only fingerprint/counters needed for completion dedup/resend, never fabricate a new event from current snapshot.
